faqs.question: What is the CodeAlpha internship program?
faqs.answer: The CodeAlpha internship is a real-world, hands-on program where you work on projects in domains like Artificial Intelligence, Web Development, Java programming, Cyber Security and more. You receive an offer letter, complete assigned tasks, and earn a QR-verified completion certificate.

faqs.question: What are the perks of this internship?
faqs.answer: Perks include an internship offer letter, a QR-verified completion certificate, a unique ID certificate, a letter of recommendation based on performance, job opportunities with placement support, and resume building support.

faqs.question: How many tasks do I need to complete to get the certificate?
faqs.answer: You must complete a minimum of 2 or 3 tasks from the task list of your domain. Submitting only one task is considered incomplete, and certificates are not issued in that case.

faqs.question: Where should I upload my project source code?
faqs.answer: Upload your complete source code to GitHub in a repository named CodeAlpha_ProjectName — for example, CodeAlpha_ImageCaptioning or CodeAlpha_Chatbot.

faqs.question: How do I submit my completed task?
faqs.answer: A submission form is shared in your internship WhatsApp group. You must submit your completed task only through that form, following the instructions in it carefully.

faqs.question: Do I need to post on LinkedIn?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share your internship status on LinkedIn tagging @CodeAlpha, and post a short video explanation of your project on LinkedIn along with your GitHub repository link.

faqs.question: How long does the internship last?
faqs.answer: The internship typically runs for 4 weeks (1 month). Complete your assigned tasks within the timeframe mentioned in your offer letter.

faqs.question: Is the internship paid?
faqs.answer: This is an unpaid, learning-focused virtual internship. Its value is the real project experience, certificates, recommendation letter and placement support you receive.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the CodeAlpha internship?
faqs.answer: Students and fresh graduates from any technical or non-technical background can apply. You just need a laptop, an internet connection, and the willingness to learn and complete the tasks.

faqs.question: How will I receive my certificate?
faqs.answer: After your submission is verified, your QR-verified completion certificate and unique ID certificate are issued and shared with you, usually via the WhatsApp group or email.

faqs.question: Can I get a letter of recommendation?
faqs.answer: Yes — a letter of recommendation is awarded based on your performance during the internship, such as quality of your projects and completing extra tasks.

faqs.question: What technologies do I need for the AI internship tasks?
faqs.answer: For the Artificial Intelligence domain you will typically use Python with libraries such as Flask, NLTK or SpaCy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch, OpenCV and music21, depending on which tasks you choose.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the deadline?
faqs.answer: If you cannot finish within the timeframe, contact the CodeAlpha team through the WhatsApp group as early as possible to discuss an extension. Unsubmitted tasks mean the internship is marked incomplete.

faqs.question: How do I contact CodeAlpha support?
faqs.answer: You can reach the team at services@codealpha.tech or services.codealpha@gmail.com, on WhatsApp at +91 9336576683, or through the website www.codealpha.tech.

faqs.question: What projects can I choose in the AI domain?
faqs.answer: AI-domain tasks include a Language Translation Tool, a Chatbot for FAQs, Music Generation with AI, and Object Detection and Tracking. You complete any 2 or 3 of them.
